questions.question: What is the first step in website development?
questions.explanation: Website development starts with planning to define purpose, goals, and user actions.

questions.question: Website development is divided into which two main segments?
questions.explanation: Websites are divided into front-end (user interface) and backend (server-side processing).

questions.question: Which part of a website is also called client-side?
questions.explanation: Front-end runs on the user’s device and is called client-side.

questions.question: Which language is NOT used in front-end development?
questions.explanation: Python is mainly used for back-end development.

questions.question: Back-end developers mainly work on which aspect?
questions.explanation: Back-end handles databases, data processing, and server logic.

questions.question: Which architecture shows interaction between client and server?
questions.explanation: Client-server architecture allows communication between user devices and servers.

questions.question: What is responsive web design mainly used for?

options.B: Adjusting website to different screen sizes

questions.explanation: Responsive design adapts layouts for mobiles, tablets, and desktops.

questions.question: Coding schemes are used to convert data into which form?
questions.explanation: Computers understand data in binary form (0s and 1s).

questions.question: ASCII stands for:

options.B: American Standard Code for Information Interchange

questions.explanation: ASCII is a standard character encoding system.

questions.question: How many characters can ASCII-7 represent?
questions.explanation: ASCII-7 uses 7 bits and represents 128 characters.

questions.question: Extended ASCII uses how many bits?
questions.explanation: Extended ASCII uses 8 bits and can represent 256 characters.

questions.question: Why was Unicode introduced?
questions.explanation: Unicode supports characters from almost all languages.

questions.question: Which version of Unicode was first introduced?
questions.explanation: Unicode was first introduced in 1991.

questions.question: JavaScript is mainly used to add which feature to websites?
questions.explanation: JavaScript adds interactivity like clicks, forms, and dynamic updates.

questions.question: JavaScript arrays are used to:

options.B: Store multiple values in one variable

questions.explanation: Arrays store multiple related values in a single variable.
